message.content: {"note_claim": "Real estate registration certificates are public information that anyone can request by paying a fee (Real Property Registration Act Art. 119), so businesses obtaining them is lawful.", "label": "PARTIAL", "quote": "登記事項証明書（土地・建物）、地図・図面証明書の交付請求", "reason": "The page describes procedures for requesting land/building registration certificates online, by mail or at counter, which is consistent with public availability, but it does not state that 'anyone' may request them or cite Article 119, nor address privacy claims."}

parsed.note_claim: Real estate registration certificates are public information that anyone can request by paying a fee (Real Property Registration Act Art. 119), so businesses obtaining them is lawful.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: 登記事項証明書（土地・建物）、地図・図面証明書の交付請求
